title: Five 400-bit field-cube components with incremental decoding

claims.statement: For the explicit 5-component systematic field-cube product over binary modulus X^200+X^30+X^19+X^11+1, with the radius-28 systematic candidate decoder in proof.md for each component, the uniform-message average block error for 1000 information bits on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 330508856547568729/500000000000000000.

The bsc-ops-v1 program for the same field-cube product and its same component decoder uses at most the integer W=28079215112395478359154444117299206555 operations on every received word, with W<=2^(124401/1000).

experiments.purpose: Verify the field modulus, exact component occupancy and combined block-error bound, memory and integer exponent inequality, and sample window-arithmetic identities. Verify affine cube differences for sample directions.
